instruction:
You are a civil stormwater modeller checking a task-owned synthetic stormwater SWMM/HEC-style report output and source-policy package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. EPA SWMM report workflows, HEC-style model report review, source manifest hashing, and negative-case verification shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-03-LH-08`
- Model input file: `MODEL-SSC03-008`
- Manual/report PDF: `REPORT-SSC03-008`
- Result table: `RESULT-SSC03-008`
- Hash/source manifest: `HASH-SSC03-008`
- Verification case matrix: `VERIFY-SSC03-008`
- Source-policy memo: `MEMO-SSC03-008`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Model subcatchments | {{ model_subcatchment_count }} |
| Report subcatchments | {{ report_subcatchment_count }} |
| Model nodes | {{ model_node_count }} |
| Report nodes | {{ report_node_count }} |
| Model links | {{ model_link_count }} |
| Report links | {{ report_link_count }} |
| Storage units | {{ storage_unit_count }} |
| Outlet result rows | {{ outlet_row_count }} |
| Required hashes | {{ required_hash_count }} |
| Present hashes | {{ present_hash_count }} |
| Manual peak flow | {{ manual_peak_flow_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Model peak flow | {{ model_peak_flow_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Allowed peak delta | {{ allowed_peak_delta_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Continuity error | {{ continuity_error_percent }} percent |
| Maximum continuity error | {{ maximum_continuity_error_percent }} percent |
| Expected negative cases | {{ expected_negative_cases }} |
| Captured negative cases | {{ captured_negative_cases }} |
| Unresolved source conflicts | {{ unresolved_source_conflicts }} |

## Checks

- Object match percent compares model and report subcatchment, node, and link counts.
- Hash completeness percent equals present hashes divided by required hashes.
- Peak delta equals absolute manual/model peak-flow difference.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when object, hash, peak-delta, continuity, negative-case, and source-conflict checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated SWMM report-output evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "object_match_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "hash_completeness_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "peak_delta_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "peak_delta_margin_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "continuity_error_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "continuity_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "storage_unit_count": <numeric_value>,
  "outlet_row_count": <numeric_value>,
  "negative_case_capture_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "unresolved_source_conflicts": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the stormwater SWMM/HEC report source-policy template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic model, report, result, hash, and negative-case source package.

[meta]
name = "swmm-hec-report-source-policy-package"
description = "stormwater model/report object matching, hash, continuity, and source-policy metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound model/report source-policy metrics from a deterministic stormwater task-owned source pack. The template combines model/report object matching, hash completeness, manual/model peak delta, continuity error margin, outlet row counts, negative-case capture, unresolved source conflicts, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "model-source-policy"
standards = ["EPA SWMM report workflows", "HEC-style model report review", "source manifest hashing", "negative-case verification"]
tags = ["civil", "stormwater", "swmm", "hec", "source-policy", "report-output", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.model_subcatchment_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MODEL-SSC03-008 model subcatchment count"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.report_subcatchment_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "REPORT-SSC03-008 report subcatchment count"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.model_node_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MODEL-SSC03-008 model node count"
min = 28.0
max = 28.0

[params.report_node_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "REPORT-SSC03-008 report node count"
min = 28.0
max = 28.0

[params.model_link_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MODEL-SSC03-008 model link count"
min = 31.0
max = 31.0

[params.report_link_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "REPORT-SSC03-008 report link count"
min = 31.0
max = 31.0

[params.storage_unit_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MODEL-SSC03-008 storage unit count"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.outlet_row_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "RESULT-SSC03-008 outlet result row count"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.required_hash_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "HASH-SSC03-008 required hash count"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.present_hash_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "HASH-SSC03-008 present hash count"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.manual_peak_flow_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "REPORT-SSC03-008 manual peak flow"
min = 1.84
max = 1.84

[params.model_peak_flow_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "RESULT-SSC03-008 model peak flow"
min = 1.812
max = 1.812

[params.allowed_peak_delta_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-008 allowed manual/model peak delta"
min = 0.05
max = 0.05

[params.continuity_error_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "REPORT-SSC03-008 continuity error"
min = 0.37
max = 0.37

[params.maximum_continuity_error_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-008 maximum continuity error"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.expected_negative_cases]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "VERIFY-SSC03-008 expected negative cases"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.captured_negative_cases]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "VERIFY-SSC03-008 captured negative cases"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.unresolved_source_conflicts]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-008 unresolved source conflicts"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[outputs.object_match_percent]
description = "Model/report object match percentage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hash_completeness_percent]
description = "Present hashes divided by required hashes"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.peak_delta_m3_s]
description = "Absolute manual/model peak flow delta"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.peak_delta_margin_m3_s]
description = "Allowed peak delta minus observed peak delta"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.continuity_error_percent]
description = "Reported continuity error"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.continuity_margin_percent]
description = "Maximum continuity error minus reported continuity error"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.storage_unit_count]
description = "Model storage unit count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.outlet_row_count]
description = "Outlet result row count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.negative_case_capture_percent]
description = "Captured negative cases divided by expected negative cases"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.unresolved_source_conflicts]
description = "Unresolved source conflict count"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for model/report source-policy checks"
tolerance = 0.03
